_comment: The GPU fleet: every host and card, with the host's admission rules. DATA, read by scripts/lib/gpu_fleet.py (claims, windows, admission, board, the guard) and by `dreamteam gpu run`. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-29-gpu-fleet-design.md. Sizes marked in `measured` were read with an instrument (nvidia-smi / free / /proc/swaps / df / lspci over ssh); change a size only from a new measurement, and say when. `dreamteam gpu inventory --check` re-measures and reports drift.
measured: 2026-09-29 09:1x PDT by cirrus-scry: nvidia-smi --query-gpu, free -m, /proc/swaps, df -BG /, nproc, lspci -vv (B60 BAR2)

_notes.cap_margin: cap = measured peak x 1.2 for fixed-shape jobs (FAMILIAR-RULES rule 3: 'measured peak plus 20%'; stage2_train's peaks are stable across runs).
_notes.grows_margin: x 1.5 for any job whose memory grows with run length (caches, arenas, variable-length inputs). FAMILIAR-RULES amendment 2026-09-28 23:4x-23:5x after two OOM kills: Canary-1B's arena (a 2-clip 4.75 GB peak + 20% = 6 GB; the full run passed 6.26 GB) and the lidar build's GDAL block cache.
_notes.vram_margin_mib: claimed VRAM on a card must leave 1 GiB (guest_run.sh: GPU free >= cap + 1 GB).
_notes.refuse_exit: 75 = EX_TEMPFAIL, retry later: the code all three GEMS launchers already use for an admission refusal.

swap._note: /swapfile 8 GB + /dev/zram0 12.5 GiB (8.2 GB used at 09:1x). zram is RAM, so its use is pressure, not spare capacity.

katana.notes: JP's workstation; the 2080 Ti also drives the desktop. Budget and headroom are the lead's caps (2026-09-28 23:2x), bounding the SUM of all guest scopes: reverie stacked 6G + 8G + 4G at 23:53, each admitted alone. GPU stutter against the compositor is NOT detected; the remedy is the pause file on JP's word.

swap._note: zram only: swap use is memory pressure (FAMILIAR-RULES 'Know the box').

disk_floors._note: rule 5: bulk data and run outputs never on the nvme root (95% full on 09-28); 10 GB is this spec's floor [proposed]

familiar.notes: Hosts the palace (postgres ~6 GB), the voice ASR and Ember (the 22.9 GB model on the B60). All GEMS work together budgets ~8 GB, one heavy job at a time (FAMILIAR-RULES rules 1-2). earlyoom stays; its kill order is set by oom_score_adj (+500 regenerable, -300 protected).

disk_floors._note: guest_run.sh: root free >= 8 GB + --disk-need; root had 11 G free at 09:1x

game.notes: An active graphical session (a shared desktop). Budgets from the lead's caps (23:2x). ~/Projects is NOT synced here, so `gpu run` installs its launcher over ssh (checksum-verified).

gpu0.notes: Asleep by default (Slumber Ward). The pair budget (sum of caps + 1 GiB OS + 0.5 GiB overlap <= RAM - 0.5 GiB) is gpu1's rule 7 applied to gpu0's own RAM: <= 11.16 GiB [proposed; drift-gems asked to confirm].

gpu1.notes: i7-920, 4 cores / 8 threads. FAMILIAR-RULES rule 7: two runs only when 2 x measured peak + 1.5 GiB <= ~10.2 GiB. A 26-band pair at 5.23 GiB each was kernel-OOM-killed at 19:29:47 on 09-28; the pad-once loader's 2.81 GiB fits (7.1). Two concurrent runs want --threads 1 (measured 14.3 vs 10.1 s/epoch; GEMS's wrapper adds it). Asleep by default; runs hold a systemd-inhibit sleep lock.

residents.name: donkey-llm.service: Qwen3.5-4B for Balaam, the emberburrito donkey familiar (port 8092)

familiar:0._residents_note: standing services that hold VRAM on this card (nvidia-smi 09:34 PDT: pid 3513, 380 MiB, user ollama; pid 4078769, 3026 MiB, user jp). Claimable VRAM = vram - residents - margin. Update from a new measurement if the services change.

familiar:xpu0.blocked_by: BIOS Resizable BAR is off: BAR2 is 16 GB against 24 GB of VRAM (lspci, 09:1x), and Intel's compute runtime exposes nothing ('Small BAR detected'; torch.xpu.device_count() == 0, Drift 2026-09-28). Vulkan works (Ember/llama.cpp). Enabling ReBAR is JP's hands at familiar's BIOS. Memory: familiar-b60-needs-rebar.
familiar:xpu0._vram_source: documented (24 GB), not measured: xpu-smi is not installed
